BOUNDARY: Plasmodium is a digenetic (two-host) obligate intracellular parasite. It completes its life between TWO hosts: human (definitive host) + female Anopheles mosquito (intermediate host) with host alternation. The asexual (sporogonic = erythrocytic + hepatic) cycle is in the human; the sexual cycle (gametogenesis) is in the mosquito. Vector = female Anopheles (only Anopheles carries it; Aedes does NOT).

4.2 General Characteristics Unicellular, eukaryotic, non-motile adult (no flagella/cilia/pseudopodia); body = membrane + cytoplasm + nucleus Obligate parasitic; lives in human liver cells (exoerythrocytic) + RBCs (erythrocytic) + mosquito gut (sexual) No food vacuole, no contractile vacuole in adult forms; ingests RBC hemoglobin Reproduction: asexual (multiple fission / schizogony / sporogony) + sexual (gametogony) with alternation of generations Causes MALARIA; periodic chills + fever ("tertian" / "quotidian" / "quartan")
